caption: The drawing depicts a single, elaborately decorated brown leather object shaped like a holster, oriented vertically against a plain, cream-colored background. The holster features carved, embossed patterns that resemble a combination of stylized leaves and geometric motifs; the leaf patterns sweep in a fan-like arrangement across the upper and midsection, while the edges are lined with a border of repeating triangular shapes. The coloration consists primarily of various shades of brown, ranging from light tan to deep chocolate, with highlights and shadows enhancing the three-dimensional and textured qualities of the leather. There are visible details and contours indicating thickness and structure, and the overall design continues uniformly throughout the piece, with the lower portion showcasing a gathered or stitched design element. The object is centered on the page, and there are no other elements present in the composition.
title: Gun Holster
